name: projectmind
description: Local-first evidence verification and project intelligence for coding agents.

scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run schema:check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.validate:windows: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run schema:check && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/structured-evidence.test.ts tests/proofpack-schema.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern="AST scanner|graph resolves|scanner includes|base-ref comparison|initialization builds|config can be loaded|verification refuses" tests/hardening.test.ts tests/projectmind.test.ts && npm run build
scripts.pack:repro: pnpm build && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true})" && pnpm pack --out artifacts/projectmind-preview-a.tgz && pnpm pack --out artifacts/projectmind-preview-b.tgz && node scripts/compare-packages.mjs artifacts/projectmind-preview-a.tgz artifacts/projectmind-preview-b.tgz
scripts.schema:check: npm run schema:proofpack && git diff --exit-code -- schemas/proofpack-v1.schema.json
